name: claude-kit
description: Personal Claude Code capability repository: skills, subagents, commands and hooks, packaged as installable plugins.

plugins.name: claude-kit-meta
plugins.description: Install and manage claude-kit itself. Provides /claude-kit-meta:install-here to enable chosen plugins for the current project, /claude-kit-meta:list to see what is available, and /claude-kit-meta:new-plugin to scaffold a new capability pack.

plugins.name: context-trim
plugins.description: Truncates long command output before it reaches the model, keeping error context and the tail summary when something fails. Also logs per-subagent cost so you can check whether delegating pays off. No agents, no prompting, nothing to remember.

plugins.name: dev-agents
plugins.description: Ten subagents with the model tier bound per role, so read-only exploration runs on haiku and only real design judgement runs on opus. Includes a delegation strategy skill that says which agent to pick and how to brief it, plus three reminder hooks: one when the main thread has been grinding alone too long, and a pair that asks for a task plan before a subagent is dispatched so a long run plus context compaction cannot lose your remaining steps.
